summary: cli/trigger.ts's Redis-unreachable path (spec: 'the add throws: report it clearly and exit 1') does not fire promptly when Redis is fully down, only when it errors fast (e.g. bad auth) — the shared fastify.redis client (plugins/redis.ts, out of my slice) is built with maxRetriesPerRequest:null and enableReadyCheck:false plus ioredis's default infinite exponential-backoff retryStrategy, both deliberate for worker resilience to blips. Against a stopped Redis container, queue.add() queued through the offline queue and blocked past a 120s wall-clock wait instead of throwing.
evidence: docker compose stop redis; node src/cli/trigger.ts demo — command exceeded a 120s timeout with no output, task had to be force-stopped; the process was still alive (not deadlocked, just waiting to reconnect) since docker compose start redis would have let it proceed
